name: calendar
description: Calendar management plugin. Provides event listing, creation, and search capabilities.
author: JARVIS Team

commands.name: list_events
commands.description: List calendar events for a given date range. Returns upcoming and past events.

start_date.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to today.

end_date.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to start_date.

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return. Default 20.

commands.name: create_event
commands.description: Create a new calendar event with title, date, time, and optional attendees.

start_time.description: Start time in HH:MM format, e.g. '09:00'

end_time.description: End time in HH:MM format, e.g. '10:00'

attendees.description: Comma-separated list of attendee names or emails

commands.name: search_events
commands.description: Search calendar events by keyword. Returns matching events with details.

keyword.description: Search keyword to match against event titles, locations, and notes

date_range.description: Optional date range filter, e.g. 'today', 'this week', 'next week', '2026-06-28'
